title: one line: what this world is

style.look: the visual language every prompt shares: era, region, mood, materials, wear
style.materials: the material vocabulary (e.g. weathered pine, river stone, wrought iron, wool)
style.avoid: what does not belong (plastic, neon, cartoon proportions, ...)

suffix.prop: single object, centered, whole object fully visible with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain pure white background, soft even studio light, no shadow on the ground, photorealistic game asset reference
suffix.card: single plant cut-out, side view, centered, whole plant visible from base to tip, plain pure white background, even light, no ground, no pot, photorealistic
suffix.slab: flat front view filling the whole frame, no border, no perspective, no frame, no wall around it
suffix.decal: top-down photograph of the mark alone on pure white paper, sparse irregular shape, soft fading edges, nothing touches the image border, no objects, no shadow
suffix.edit: keep the exact same object identity, design, materials, colours, proportions and camera angle; plain pure white background; single object, whole object visible

generation.concept_suffix: game environment concept art, eye-level camera at 1.7 m, realistic scale, physically plausible lighting, rich lived-in detail, no people, no text
generation.concept_edit_suffix: same camera, same architecture and layout, keep what is already there and add the requested detail; game environment concept art, no people, no text
